title: Met Someone Last Night at Wedding
content: Last night was filled with mall world dreams, wondering if anyone attended a wedding or big celebration in mallworld last night? Male, strawberry blonde ish hair, around 37yo , I actually crashed the wedding for fun, not sure if this man was a guest or another wedding crasher? Anyway I lost him in crowd and only found him again just before I woke up. May have had a name like Graham? I feel you needed to tell me something important... or that we just needed to talk? U were with a group of males , some of which were urging us to connect , a couple of guys were trying to keep is apart. Are u a person in this reality or in my other reality only?
